verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs describe rolling production back to a previous deployment for fast incident recovery, without a rebuild. Rolling releases can also be rolled back, and webhooks emit a dedicated 'Deployment Rollback' event, so rollback is a first-class platform action. missing for 10: explicit evidence that rollback is a one-click dashboard action, confirmation that any arbitrary past deployment (not just the immediately previous one) can be targeted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
